scope: Local rehearsal of the explicit GitHub Actions browser-smoke selection. This is not a GitHub-hosted workflow result or a full E2E/hardware certification.

checks.name: Workflow YAML parsing and full action SHA pins

coverage: Installed-extension detection, quality selection, direct/HLS/DASH downloads and saved files
Persistence, worker interruption, checkpoint recovery, cancellation and permission removal
Popup activity in ten languages, including RTL
Controlled SDK Cast lifecycle and popup/library handoff
Timed metadata, exact prefix/full-transfer byte ranges, opaque fragments and codec/HTML guards

correctedFailures.cause: The background prefix-metadata parser emitted the known timed-ID3 warning outside the existing media logging policy.
correctedFailures.fix: Use the exact warning policy lazily for bounded metadata parsing; reference-count concurrent logging scopes and retain unknown warnings and codec refusal.

correctedFailures.cause: The legacy Range assertion counted four transfer requests but omitted two current bounded prechecks.
correctedFailures.fix: Assert the two exact prefix ranges separately from the four exact fixture transfer ranges; keep file, track and duration assertions.

limits: The selected browser suite uses original local fixtures and controlled SDK responses.
Other E2E files remain available and are not included in this 62-test selection.
Physical Cast/AirPlay receivers, public providers, private accounts and large-file benchmarks are not certified here.
GitHub Pages deployment and GitHub Release publication are separate maintainer actions.
